status_vocabulary.live: Finding not yet confirmed fixed against current output; treat as open.
status_vocabulary.superseded_by_decision: Overridden by a recorded project decision in docs/DECISIONS.md.
status_vocabulary.deferred_no_human_decision: Human adjudication was required and explicitly declined; value remains unverified AI output.

error_type_vocabulary.spelling_retention: AI silently normalized a misspelling present in the source. Transcription Policy S2 requires transcribing as written, then giving the correction in [brackets].
error_type_vocabulary.spelling_ocr: AI misread the source; the transcript text is simply wrong.
error_type_vocabulary.punctuation: AI altered punctuation. Policy S2 requires retaining punctuation exactly.
error_type_vocabulary.date_misread: AI misread a date; error propagated into multiple fields.
error_type_vocabulary.provenance_unverifiable: Value may be correct but cannot be traced to anything on the item. Reviewer wrote 'I have no idea where this information came from'.
error_type_vocabulary.unverifiable_insertion: AI produced text not present in / not verifiable against the source (hallucinated fill of damaged or illegible regions).
error_type_vocabulary.omission: Source text present on the item was not transcribed at all.
error_type_vocabulary.should_be_illegible: AI guessed at an unreadable word instead of marking [illegible] / [unclear].
